title: An Epistemic and Aleatoric Decomposition of Arbitrariness to Constrain the Set of Good Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical decomposition of model instability in machine learning into epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. While it addresses 'ethical' concerns such as procedural justice and systematic arbitrariness as motivations for model fairness, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or faith-based frameworks.
